# rms_user (Resource)

Manages a Teltonika RMS User.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rms_user" "admin" {
  username   = "admin"
  email      = "admin@example.com"
  role       = "admin"
  company_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `company_id` (Number) The company ID.
- `email` (String) The email address.
- `role` (String) The user role.
- `username` (String) The username.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier for the user.
